# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.2

Version 1.4.2 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.1

- **Rooms hosted on Windows, for guests from other networks: "Allow in Windows Firewall".**
  - **The problem:** when Windows first asks about the game, its prompt allows it on private networks only. It also
    adds a rule blocking the game on public networks, and Windows often counts a home connection as public. A block
    rule wins over any allow rule. Packets from a guest on another network can then be dropped, especially when the
    guest's router or mobile network sends them from another outside port than the room has seen. A phone has no
    such firewall, which is why hosting from a phone worked.
  - **The fix:** while hosting, press **Allow in Windows Firewall** on the multiplayer page. After Windows asks for an
    administrator's consent, the game's old firewall rules are removed and replaced by one allowing it on every
    network. A Windows host is reminded of the button when a room opens.
- **The Enter that sends a chat line no longer opens the pockets** (PC). The chat box closed in the frame Enter was
  pressed, and the game then read the Enter key still held down as Start.
- **The Nintendo logo at start-up.**
  - **The problem:** on the GameCube a separate boot thread draws the logo while the game loads, so the first logo
    screen draws nothing itself. The port does not run that thread. On PC the screen stayed black, and on Android it
    showed whatever was left on screen.
  - **The fix:** the first logo screen now draws the logo, as the ones after the title demo always did.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0, v1.4.1 and v1.4.2 can be in the same room.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.2-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.2-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.2-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.2-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Chat, with real key presses sent to the game window (Linux, X): T, "hello", Enter.
  - The line is sent and the pockets stay closed.
  - With the old code the same keys opened the pockets.
- Start-up (Linux): the Nintendo logo fades in and out before the title demo; before, those frames were black.
- Firewall button:
  - The firewall code builds for 32- and 64-bit Windows.
  - Under Wine, the exact command string the game passes splits and quotes as intended.
  - It has not been run on a real Windows PC.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.2, versionCode 10402).

## Known limitations

- Joining a PC's room from another network has still not been tried with real networks. If it still fails after the
  firewall button, open an [issue](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/issues) with the "Internet address" line
  from the multiplayer page.
- The start-up logo on a real Android device has not been seen yet.
- The limitations of v1.4.0 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
